help.footer.title: ## Using a GifOS app
help.footer.invite: - **Invite** — share this app live. Friends open one link and everyone uses the same app together.
help.footer.save: - **Save** — download a snapshot GIF: the app plus whatever it has saved, yours to keep.
help.footer.steal: - **Steal** — if you joined someone else, copy the app onto your desktop (with their data, as they joined, or clean).
help.footer.abilities: - The chip is **Abilities** — what this app may do on this device. Tap to review or turn things off.
help.remix.title: ## Make it yours
help.remix.body: Every GifOS app is a GIF you can remix. **Save** that GIF, drop it into your favorite AI chat, and ask it to change the game — a dark mode, bigger buttons, a new rule, whatever you want. Add the GIF it gives you back to your Home Screen and play your remixed version. You do not need to know how to code. This is how GifOS apps get better: you make the next one.
help.empty.title: # Help
help.empty.body: This app did not ship its own Help page.

help.report.title: ## Something wrong?
help.report.body: {link} — the issue form opens with this app, page and build already filled in; just say what happened.
